Hanno Eco-tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/syogakuji-zazen-autumn/

At Shogakuji, an officially recognized Soto Zen meditation hall, you'll experience zen training centered on seated meditation (zazen) surrounded by Hanno's natural beauty—listening to the sounds of the river, wind, and birdsong.

【Fee】
7,000 yen per person (includes guide, lunch, sutra copying, and insurance)

【Capacity】
20 people

【Guide】
Ishii Sanae (Shogakuji)

【What to bring】
Wear comfortable long pants suitable for seated meditation, or bring a pair to change into
location: 集合 正覚寺 飯能市上名栗2326（国際興業バス「名郷」下車徒歩1分）
summary: Training experience at a zen temple (seated meditation, dharma talk, sutra copying, vegetarian cuisine, practice)
